title: ferula sulcata var. crassicosta

The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of Ferula sulcata var. crassicosta include alkaloids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, such as cardiotonic, expectorant, and diuretic actions.
